_comment: YouTrack MCP - JetBrains' built-in remote server (YouTrack 2025.2+, https://www.jetbrains.com/help/youtrack/server/model-context-protocol-server.html), registered for every tool once ensure_youtrack_mcp has stored a URL and permanent token. mcp-remote bridges it to stdio so every tool gets the same entry and reads the Authorization header from the mode-600 file below, which keeps the token out of every tool's config and out of the process list. $YOUTRACK_URL is the stored site URL (YOUTRACK_URL_FILE); `marker` limits stale removal to entries that still read our key file. Keep both paths in sync with YOUTRACK_URL_FILE / YOUTRACK_KEY_FILE in lib/common.sh. Version pinned - bump it deliberately.
